caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing male figure with brown skin, dressed in traditional attire. The figure is shown in a contrapposto stance, with the left leg forward and right leg back, standing on a rectangular pedestal with a lower and upper step. His left hand is raised to his forehead as if shading his eyes while his right arm hangs by his side, holding a cylindrical object. The figure wears a green tunic with a diagonal red sash across the chest, a blue and green belt, and a cloak draped over the left shoulder. His headdress features several large green feathers fanning upward. He has brown sandals on his feet and several decorative armbands in red, blue, and yellow colors. The background is a flat, light tan color, and a fine line border surrounds the entire image. The artist’s name, "ELMER C. ANDERSON," is inscribed in small letters at the bottom left, and “SCALE 1/8 FULL SIZE” is inscribed at the bottom right.
title: Cigar Store Indian
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
